| TunerStudio label | Setting | Units | Range | Help (as TunerStudio shows it) |

| Gathering Data | `ltft_enabled` | choice |  | Enables lambda sensor long term fuel corrections data gathering into LTFT trim tables |
| Time const for Idle region | `ltft_timeConstant1` | sec | 0.1 … 3000 | Commonly referred as Integral gain. Time constant for correction while in this cell: this sets responsiveness of the closed loop correction. A value of 30.0 means it will try to make most of the correction within 30 seconds, and a value of 300.0 will try to correct within 5 minutes. Lower values makes the correction more sensitive, higher values slow the correction down. 1 |

Lower values makes the correction more sensitive, higher values slow the correction down. 2 |

| Max add | `ltft_maxAdd` | % | 0 … 25 | Maximum % that the long term fuel trim can add |
| Max remove | `ltft_maxRemove` | % | 0 … 25 | Maximum % that the long term fuel trim can remove |
| Learning deadband | `ltft_deadband` | % | 0 … 3 | When close to correct AFR, pause correction. This can improve stability by not changing the adjustment if the error is extremely small, but is not required. |
| Apply Correction | `ltft_correctionEnabled` | choice |  | Apply LTFT trims into fuel calculation on top of VE table. We do not adjust VE table automatically, please click 'Apply to VE' if you want to adjust your VE tables and reset trims. |
